exposure: Midwifery-led interdisciplinary model of antenatal outreach care
outcome: Quality of care indicators (presentation in first trimester, alcohol and smoking, ultrasound and blood-borne virus screening)
cohort: 213 pregnant women in Aboriginal communities in the Fitzroy Valley of Western Australia
finding: A new model of antenatal care led to increased access to antenatal care and improvements in quality-of-care indicators, but no significant improvements in neonatal outcome indicators.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported
